message:
Thanks Danielle Cathleen for that update about CBS. This explains why I do not have my collect calls on my November Verizon statement that I received on yesterday. I get collect calls on both of my lines. I never trust these people so I tend to log my calls on a calendar.

The entire industry of carriers for the prisons have changed. All of the dominate carriers have exited the market. We only have left the smaller carriers that do not have billing names and addresses for customers.

The bottom line is that they do not want to be bothered with collect calls. They want their money up front.  They figure if you use up your limit before the 90 days then you will have to prepay if you want to talk. You can go over that $240 as long as you pay up front.What a shame.
